name: Echo CS-271T
blurb: 26.9 cc top-handle. Echo's chart lists a 12″ bar in two gauges: .050″ (91PX45CQ, 45 drive links) and .043″ (90PX45CQ, 45 drive links).
intro: The CS-271T is a top-handle saw. Echo's specification table lists a 12″ bar and 26.9 cc. The Bars and Chains chart prints two 12″ rows under CS-271T: .050″ gauge, 91PX45CQ, 45 drive links, 5/32″ file, bar 12A0CD3745C; and .043″ gauge, 90PX45CQ, 45 drive links, 11/64″ file, bar 12A4CD3745C. Same length, same drive-link count, two gauges. The bar part number is the one that changes.

bars.note: Echo bar 12A0CD3745C; chain 91PX45CQ. Non-replaceable-nose bar. .050″ gauge, 5/32″ file.
Echo bar 12A4CD3745C; chain 90PX45CQ. Non-replaceable-nose bar. .043″ gauge, 11/64″ file.
